projectDescription: A CPU-only audio analysis and sound synthesis toolkit that gives AI coding agents the ability to hear, describe, match, and generate sounds — exposed as a CLI, Python API, and MCP server.
keyFeatures: Describe any audio file in natural language with calibrated z-score tags
Match and rank audio files against text descriptions using CLAP embeddings
Find best moments inside long recordings with sample-accurate trims
Detect real recordings vs code-synthesized audio (ROC-AUC 0.92)
Generate sounds from code using physical synthesis with an evolutionary critic loop (earshot forge)
Translate recordings into re-renderable code via analysis by synthesis (earshot fit)
Ship a bank of 201 DSP-rendered sound effects with knob control (earshot sfx / kit)
Expose all tools as an MCP server for Claude Code and other AI agents
Full Python API — all commands available as importable functions
CPU-only — no GPU required, runs locally with no network calls after model download
